others.deal: DICK'S Sporting Goods / Foot Locker x Caitlin Clark

caption:
Sydney FC just sold the walk from the bus to the sheds.

CONNOR has signed a two-year deal as the club's Official Off-Field Style Partner, dressing the first team, coaches and officials for matchday arrivals and club functions. Under Armour stays on as the on-field partner, so this is a different moment in the matchday. CONNOR has 200+ stores across Australia and NZ to put it to work.

Also in today's deals: Toyota Australia x Brisbane Heat, Klein Tools x Port Adelaide, NTT x McLaren, DICK'S Sporting Goods / Foot Locker x Caitlin Clark and American Express x NBA / WNBA.
